name: NapCat QQ
description: QQ chat channel plugin for OpenClaw via NapCat (OneBot 11)
author: ProperSAMA

agentId.title: Default Agent ID
agentId.description: Optional default OpenClaw agent for NapCat; explicit OpenClaw bindings take precedence

allowUsers.title: Allowed User IDs
allowUsers.description: Only accept messages from these QQ user IDs (empty = accept all)

adminUsers.title: Administrator QQ IDs
adminUsers.description: QQ user IDs allowed to bypass the random group trigger rules with an @ mention and to wake the bot during curfew

groupWhitelist.title: Group Whitelist
groupWhitelist.description: Only accept messages from these QQ group IDs when non-empty

enableGroupMessages.title: Enable Group Messages
enableGroupMessages.description: When enabled, process group messages; mention and probabilistic trigger rules apply

streaming_mode.title: Streaming Mode
streaming_mode.description: Stream replies as incremental QQ messages instead of waiting for the final combined response

enable_progress_messages.title: Enable Progress Messages
enable_progress_messages.description: Send assistant intermediate progress (commentary) messages to QQ as well, throttled to 1 per 3s per conversation

groupReplyQuote.title: Quote Reply in Groups
groupReplyQuote.description: In group chats, reply by quoting the triggering message ([CQ:reply]) instead of @-mentioning the sender. Off by default; overridable per conversation

conversationConfigDir.title: Per-Conversation Config Directory
conversationConfigDir.description: Directory of per-conversation JSON overrides (default.json plus <group|private>-<id>.json). A missing directory disables the feature

plainTextMode.title: Plain Text Mode
plainTextMode.description: Convert outgoing Markdown-style text to QQ-friendly plain text

groupMentionOnly.title: Require Mention in Group
groupMentionOnly.description: When enabled, only @ messages are eligible; administrator @ mentions bypass random rules while non-admin @ messages use the probability/cooldown path. When disabled, unmentioned messages are eligible too

groupTriggerProbability.title: Group Random Trigger Probability
groupTriggerProbability.description: Chance (0-1) used when a group message is eligible for random triggering; non-admin @ messages and unmentioned messages when groupMentionOnly is false use this probability

groupTriggerCooldownMinutes.title: Group Random Trigger Cooldown (Minutes)
groupTriggerCooldownMinutes.description: Minimum minutes between successful random group triggers; a failed probability roll does not start the cooldown. Administrator @ messages bypass it when groupMentionAlwaysTriggers is true

groupMentionAlwaysTriggers.title: Admin Mention Always Triggers
groupMentionAlwaysTriggers.description: When enabled, an administrator @ mention bypasses the random trigger probability and cooldown; non-admin mentions and all messages when disabled use the probability/cooldown path

curfewEnabled.title: Enable Daily Curfew
curfewEnabled.description: Reject group messages during the daily curfew window; non-admins receive the sleeping reply, while administrators can still trigger by @

curfewStartTime.title: Curfew Start Time
curfewStartTime.description: Daily curfew start time in HH:MM (24-hour clock)

curfewEndTime.title: Curfew End Time
curfewEndTime.description: Daily curfew end time in HH:MM; normal handling resumes at this time the next day

curfewTimezone.title: Curfew Timezone
curfewTimezone.description: IANA timezone used for curfew times, e.g. Asia/Shanghai; empty uses the host timezone

curfewReplyText.title: Curfew Reply
curfewReplyText.description: Message sent to non-admin group senders during curfew; supports emoji or CQ codes

enablePrivateTypingStatus.title: Enable Private Typing Status
enablePrivateTypingStatus.description: Show QQ 'typing' status in private chats while OpenClaw is processing a reply

mediaProxyEnabled.title: Enable Media Proxy
mediaProxyEnabled.description: Expose /napcat/media endpoint so NapCat can fetch media from OpenClaw host

publicBaseUrl.title: OpenClaw Public Base URL
publicBaseUrl.description: Base URL reachable by NapCat device, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:18789

mediaProxyToken.title: Media Proxy Token
mediaProxyToken.description: Required access token when the media proxy is enabled

mediaProxyAllowedRoots.title: Media Proxy Allowed Roots
mediaProxyAllowedRoots.description: Absolute host directories whose local media files may be served by the proxy

voiceBasePath.title: Voice Base Path
voiceBasePath.description: Base directory for relative audio files (e.g. /tmp/napcat-voice)

groupFileFolder.title: Group File Default Folder
groupFileFolder.description: Optional NapCat group file folder path used by /upload_group_file

groupFileHostPrefix.title: Group File Host Prefix
groupFileHostPrefix.description: Host path prefix that is mounted into NapCat container (e.g. /Users/me/shared)

groupFileContainerPrefix.title: Group File Container Prefix
groupFileContainerPrefix.description: Container path prefix matching host prefix (e.g. /app/shared)

groupFileStageHostDir.title: Group File Stage Host Dir
groupFileStageHostDir.description: Host directory (mounted into NapCat container) to stage files before upload

groupFileStageContainerDir.title: Group File Stage Container Dir
groupFileStageContainerDir.description: Container directory corresponding to stage host dir (e.g. /app/napcat/plugins/upload-staging)

enableInboundLogging.title: Enable Inbound Message Logging
enableInboundLogging.description: Log all received QQ/group messages before allowlist filtering

inboundLogDir.title: Inbound Log Directory
inboundLogDir.description: Directory to store per-user/per-group inbound logs

webhookSecret.title: Webhook Signing Secret
webhookSecret.description: Required inbound HMAC secret; must match the NapCat HTTP client token

token.title: HTTP API Token
token.description: Token for authenticating with NapCat HTTP server (Bearer token)
